image_prompt: Inside a missile-defence command room in Alaska. A slim three-stage missile-defence interceptor rocket launches straight up out of a flat round concrete silo hatch set flush with the snow, a blinding white and orange exhaust flame and billowing glowing steam lighting the snow and the dark pine trees.
